question: A pipe can fill a cistern in 11 hours. Due to a leak in the bottom it is filled in 13 hours. When the cistern is full, in how much time will it be emptied by the leak?
solution:
**Given:**

A pipe can fill a cistern in 11 hours.

Due to a leak in the bottom it is filled in 13 hours.

**Concept used:**

If a pipe can fill a tank in x hours, part of a tank filled in one hour = dfrac{1}{x}

**Calculations:**

Pipe can fill in 13 hours, due to leakage it is filled in 11 hours.

According to the problem,

Part of tank required to empty = dfrac{1}{13} - dfrac{1}{11}
